y-m-69-02.title: Lanƙwasa da aka zana da igiya da ƙusoshi biyu
y-m-69-02.topic: Ma’anar ellipse (jimillar tazarori daga maki biyu)
y-m-69-02.goal: Ga lanƙwasar da aka zana da ƙusoshi biyu da igiya, sabunta hasashe yayin bayyana bayani mataki-mataki, yanke hukunci kan siffar da sharadin “jimillar tazarori tsayayyiya ce” ke samarwa, har da yanayin da ba za a iya zana lanƙwasa ba; sannan ka gina maki da suka cika sharadin.
y-m-69-02.material: Wani mai lambu ya buga ƙusoshi biyu a ƙasa da tazarar 6 m (F da F′), ya ɗaura ƙarshen igiya mai tsawon 10 m a ƙusoshin. Yana ja igiyar a miƙe da kan sanda, ya zagaya yana zana lanƙwasa. Bari maki a kan sandar ya zama P. Igiya ta kasu gida biyu, PF da PF′, kuma tsawonsu koyaushe yana jimilla 10 m. Bari O ya zama tsakiyar sashen FF′.

y-m-69-02.thinking.2: Gina maki da suka cika sharadin da kanka

y-m-69-02.prereq.2: An riga an gabatar da ellipse a matsayin “saitin maki da tazararsu zuwa maki biyu jimilla tsayayyiya ce” (ko ba a yi ba, za ka iya bin bayanan wannan aiki).
y-m-69-02.s.s1.prompt: Ana bayyana bayani ɗaya bayan ɗaya. A kowane mataki, zaɓi hasashe ta amfani da abin da ka sani yanzu kawai, ka duba yadda bayanin da aka bayyana ya canza hasashen.

y-m-69-02.s.s1.hint.1: Kwatanta tsawon igiya da tazara tsakanin ƙusoshi, ka yi tunanin sharadin da zai sa lanƙwasa ta bayyana.
y-m-69-02.s.s1.st.0.info: Ƙusoshin suna da tazarar 6 m, igiyar kuma 10 m ce. Sanya sashen FF′ a kan axis a kwance, bari h ya zama tazara daga O zuwa mafi nisan wurin da lanƙwasar ta kai a alkiblar da ta tsaye da FF′ (sama).
y-m-69-02.s.s1.st.0.ask: Yi hasashen h bisa abin da ka sani yanzu kawai.
y-m-69-02.s.s1.st.0.after: Ba za ka iya sanin ƙimar daidai tukuna ba; kewayo kawai za ka iya bayarwa. Idan kan sanda yana sama da O kai tsaye, kuma ɓangarorin igiya biyu suna da tsawo iri ɗaya, kowanne 5 m ne, saboda haka h dole ya gaza 5 m.
y-m-69-02.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ka yanke hukunci ta kwatanta da 3 m kawai, rabin tazarar ƙusoshi. Ba ka yi la’akari da yadda tsawon igiya 10 m ke shafar h ba.
y-m-69-02.s.s1.st.0.o.b: h aƙalla 3 m ne kuma bai wuce kusan 5 m ba.
y-m-69-02.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ka yi hasashen kewayon ta amfani da gaskiyar cewa igiyar ta kasu gida biyu.
y-m-69-02.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Wataƙila ba ka haɗa gaskiyar cewa jimillar igiyar 10 m ce da kowane sashe yana kusan 5 m ba.

y-m-69-02.s.s1.st.1.after: A alwatikan OFT, OF=3, FT=5, kusurwar dama kuma tana O. Don haka h=√(5²−3²)=4 m. Hasashenka na farko cewa bai wuce 5 m ba daidai ne, yanzu kuma an kayyade ƙimar.
y-m-69-02.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ka karanta tsawon sashe ɗaya na igiya kai tsaye a matsayin tsayi. Wannan sashe yana karkacewa.

y-m-69-02.s.s1.st.2.after: Idan P yana kan sashen FF′, PF+PF′=6; amma a maki da ba sa kan sashen, PF+PF′ ya fi 6. Saboda haka idan igiya 6 m ce, sashen FF′ da kansa ne duk lanƙwasar. Ellipse tana bayyana ne kawai idan igiyar ta fi 6 m.

y-m-69-02.s.s1.st.3.after: Ga kowane P, PF+PF′ dole ya kai aƙalla FF′=6 (jimillar gefe biyu na alwatika aƙalla ta uku ce). Idan igiya 5 m ce, ba za a iya ma ja ta miƙe tare da ɗaure ƙarshenta a ƙusoshin ba, saboda haka ba a zana lanƙwasa.
y-m-69-02.s.s1.st.3.r.a: Ka ci gaba kawai da ra’ayin cewa lanƙwasa na ƙara ƙanƙanta yayin da igiya ke gajarta.
y-m-69-02.s.s1.st.3.o.b: Igiya ta yi gajarta sosai ba za a ja ta miƙe ba.
y-m-69-02.s.s1.st.3.r.b: Ka lura cewa igiya ba za ta iya kai tazarar 6 m tsakanin ƙusoshin ba.
y-m-69-02.s.s1.st.3.o.c: Ana zana wani ɓangare na sashen FF′ kawai.
y-m-69-02.s.s1.st.3.r.c: Ka yi amfani da siffar da ta bayyana ga igiya 6 m kai tsaye ga igiya 5 m.
y-m-69-02.s.s1.st.3.o.d: Ya danganta da wurin ɗaurin igiya.
y-m-69-02.s.s1.st.3.r.d: Ka mai da hankali ga wani sharadin igiya maimakon gaskiyar cewa ba za ta kai tsakanin ƙusoshin ba.

y-m-69-09.goal: Ware bayanin da ake buƙata da wanda ba a buƙata don nemo yankin juyawar tsaye na murabba’i mai karkata, gina tsayi da dama da suka cika sharadin, sannan ka gwada da lambobi hasashen cewa “yayin da karkacewa ke ƙaruwa, inuwa tana ƙaruwa”.

Gefen 2 m biyun suna layi ɗaya da ƙasa. A ɗauka hasken rana yana faɗowa a tsaye da ƙasa, S kuma yankin inuwar (juyawar tsaye) da farantin ya yi a ƙasa ne.

y-m-69-03.goal: Tabbatar cewa akwai hyperbola da dama masu asymptotes iri ɗaya, yanke hukunci kan ƙarin bayanin girma da ake buƙata don kayyade hyperbola guda, sannan ka gina ma’aunai da suka cika sharuddan.
y-m-69-03.material: Akwai hyperbola x²/a²−y²/b²=1 (karanta: x squared over a squared minus y squared over b squared equals 1; a>0, b>0), cibiyarta a asali, babban axis (axis ɗin da ke haɗa vertices biyu) kuma yana kan axis x. Asymptotes biyu na hyperbola su ne y=(3/4)x da y=−(3/4)x. Ba a nuna raka’ar tsawo ba.

y-m-69-01.s.s1.explain: Layi na 3 ne kuskure. Directrix yana ɗaya gefen kishiyar focus daga vertex; idan focus (−2,0) ne, directrix x=2 ne. Layi 1, 2 da 4 lissafinsu daidai ne. y-m-69-01.s.s2.r.c: Wannan yana tabbatar wuri yana kan lanƙwasa kawai; ba ya nuna ko matsayin focus da directrix daidai ne.

y-m-69-07.title: Wane irin siffa maki a sarari da suke da tazara iri ɗaya daga maki biyu suke samarwa?
y-m-69-07.topic: Maki a sararin haɗin gwiwa da suke da tazara iri ɗaya daga maki biyu.
y-m-69-07.goal: Ƙirƙiri misalai don ganin yadda gogewar jirgin (maki masu tazara iri ɗaya daga maki biyu suna samar da layi) ke sauyawa a sarari, sannan ka yanke hukunci kan siffar ta duba ko maki da ka ƙirƙira suna kan layi guda.
y-m-69-07.material: A jirgi, maki masu tazara iri ɗaya daga A da B sun samar da tsakiyar bisector (layi) na sashin AB. A sarari akwai maki A(0, 0, 0) da B(2, 4, 4), muna kuma la'akari da maki P(x,y,z) da suka cika PA=PB. An cire ma'aunin tsawo.
y-m-69-07.thinking.0: Gwada abin da ke faruwa idan aka ɗauki gogewar jirgi zuwa sarari.
y-m-69-07.thinking.1: Samar da shaida daga misalan lambobi.
y-m-69-07.thinking.2: Gano abin da misalan suke nuni da shi.
y-m-69-07.prereq.0: Dabarar nisan tsakanin maki biyu a sararin haɗin gwiwa √((x₁−x₂)²+(y₁−y₂)²+(z₁−z₂)²)
y-m-69-07.prereq.1: Ma'anar tsakiyar bisector na sashi a jirgi.
y-m-69-07.s.s1.prompt: Wace siffa dukkan maki P a sarari masu cika PA=PB suke samarwa?
y-m-69-07.s.s1.hint.0: Ka tuna dalilin da ya sa a jirgi layi ne, sannan ka ƙirga alkiblu nawa suke tsaye wa AB a sarari.
y-m-69-07.s.s1.hint.1: Rubuta PA²=PB² da haɗin gwiwa, sannan ka duba irin lissafin da ake samu bayan sauƙaƙawa.
y-m-69-07.s.s1.r.a: Ka fahimci 'tazara iri ɗaya' a jirgi a matsayin tsakiyar sashi kaɗai. Ba ka gwada ko akwai wasu maki da suke daidaita tazara banda tsakiyar ba.
y-m-69-07.s.s1.o.b: Jirgi da yake tsaye wa sashin AB kuma ya ratsa tsakiyarsa.
y-m-69-07.s.s1.r.b: Ka tuna cewa sharadin tazara iri ɗaya a sarari yana zama sigar sarari ta tsakiyar bisector.
y-m-69-07.s.s1.o.c: Layi guda da ya ratsa tsakiyar kuma yake tsaye wa AB.
y-m-69-07.s.s1.r.c: Ka ɗauki gogewar jirgi zuwa sarari ta ƙara haɗin gwiwa ɗaya kawai. Har yanzu ba ka gwada cewa akwai alkiblu fiye da ɗaya da suke tsaye wa shi ba.
y-m-69-07.s.s1.r.d: Ka gauraya 'tazara iri ɗaya daga wuri guda' (ƙwallo) da 'tazara iri ɗaya daga wurare biyu'.
y-m-69-07.s.s1.explain: Sauƙaƙa PA²=PB² yana ba da lissafi madaidaici guda x+2y+2z=9. Maki masu cika wannan lissafi jirgi ne. Jirgin yana ratsa tsakiyar (1, 2, 2), kuma yana tsaye wa alkiblar AB, (2, 4, 4).
y-m-69-07.s.s2.prompt: Ƙirƙiri maki P(x,y,z) 3 mabambanta masu haɗin gwiwa cikakku da suka cika PA=PB.
y-m-69-07.s.s2.hint.0: Fara da P a tsakiyar sashin AB, sannan ka sauya haɗin gwiwa ɗaya a lokaci guda kana kwatanta tazarori.
y-m-69-07.s.s2.hint.1: Idan ka rubuta murabba'in kowane tazara, ka daidaita su ka sauƙaƙa, za ka ga dangantakar haɗin gwiwa.
y-m-69-07.s.s2.ok.c1: Dukkan haɗin gwiwa cikakkun lambobi ne.
y-m-69-07.s.s2.fail.c1: x, y, z duka dole su zama cikakkun lambobi.
y-m-69-07.s.s2.ok.c2: PA da PB sun yi daidai (murabba'insu daidai ne).
y-m-69-07.s.s2.fail.c2: Murabba'in tazarar PA da PB ba su yi daidai ba. Lissafa murabba'in tazara zuwa kowane wuri, sannan ka kwatanta.
y-m-69-07.s.s2.explain: Misali, (1, 2, 2), (3, 0, 3), da (1, 4, 0). (1, 2, 2) tsakiyar A da B ne. Maki ukun duka suna cika x+2y+2z=9. Idan ka duba ko maki ukun suna kan layi guda, za ka iya yanke ko wannan saitin layi ne ko jirgi.
y-m-69-07.s.s2.because.prompt: Rubuta yadda za ka duba ko maki ukun suna kan layi guda, sannan ka bayyana yadda wannan ya yarda ko ya saɓa wa ra'ayin farko cewa 'layi ne'.
y-m-69-07.s.s2.because.hint.0: Rubuta alkiblar da ke haɗa maki biyu a matsayin vector, sannan ka kwatanta ta da alkiblar wani biyun.
y-m-69-07.s.s2.because.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin dalilin da ya sa saitin ba zai zama layi ba idan maki ukun ba sa kan layi guda.
y-m-69-07.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ka lissafa kai tsaye ko alkiblu daga wuri ɗaya zuwa sauran biyun iri ɗaya ne?
y-m-69-07.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Idan maki ukun da ka samu suka kasance a kan layi guda bisa sa'a, ka gwada da ƙarin maki?
y-m-69-07.s.s2.because.model.0: Vector (2,−2,1) daga (1,2,2) zuwa (3,0,3) da vector (0,2,−2) daga (1,2,2) zuwa (1,4,0) ba layi ɗaya ba ne, saboda haka maki ukun ba sa kan layi guda. Don haka saitin ba zai zama layi ba; jirgi ne.
y-m-69-07.s.s2.because.model.1: Idan maki uku suna kan layi guda, alkiblu daga maki ɗaya zuwa sauran biyun dole iri ɗaya ne ko akasin juna. Amma (1,2,2)→(3,0,3)=(2,−2,1), yayin da (1,2,2)→(1,4,0)=(0,2,−2), alkiblun sun bambanta. Suna samar da jirgi, ba layi ba.

y-m-69-06.title: Ta wace hanya za ka yi tuƙi domin ketare kogin kai tsaye?
y-m-69-06.topic: Jimillar vector a jirgin da gudu
y-m-69-06.goal: Ɗauki kwararar kogi da saurin kwale-kwale a matsayin jimillar vector, tsara vector gudu da dama da suka cika sharuddan, sannan ka yanke ko manufa ɗaya za ta yiwu idan kwararar ta sauya.
y-m-69-06.material: Kogi yana gudana gabas a ko'ina da 3 m/s (arewa sama, gabas dama). Ana iya tuƙa kwale-kwale da vector gudu v=(p,q) dangane da ruwa (p bangaren gabas ne, q bangaren arewa, m/s), kuma iyakar gudunsa 5 m/s ce, don haka p²+q²≤25. Ainihin gudun kwale-kwale kamar yadda ƙasa ke gani shi ne v+(3, 0)=(p+3,q). Kana farawa daga gabar kudu, kana son isa wurin da yake daidai da kai a gabar arewa. A ɗauka kwararar kogi tana tsayayye ba tare da la'akari da wuri ko lokaci ba.

y-m-69-06.thinking.2: Yanke hukunci kan abin da zai yiwu idan sharudda sun sauya.

y-m-69-06.s.s1.prompt: Me ke faruwa idan ka tuƙa kwale-kwalen zuwa arewa da iyakar gudu (v=(0, 5))?
y-m-69-06.s.s1.hint.0: Tara vector gudun kwale-kwale da na kwarara, sannan ka rubuta ainihin gudu ta bangarori.
y-m-69-06.s.s1.hint.1: Duba ko bangaren gabas na ainihin gudu 0 ne ko a'a.
y-m-69-06.s.s1.o.a: Kwale-kwalen yana karkata gabas, ya sauka dama da wurin da yake daidai da kai.
y-m-69-06.s.s1.r.a: Ka yi la'akari da tura kwale-kwalen gabas da kogi ke yi, saboda haka ainihin gudu yana da bangaren gabas.
y-m-69-06.s.s1.o.b: Yana sauka daidai a wurin da yake daidai da kai.
y-m-69-06.s.s1.r.b: Ka ɗauka alkiblar da kwale-kwalen yake fuskanta ita ce alkiblar tafiyarsa, ka cire tasirin kwararar.
y-m-69-06.s.s1.o.c: Ko wace alkibla ce, koyaushe yana tafiya zuwa ƙasa da kwarara kawai.
y-m-69-06.s.s1.r.c: Ka ƙara girmama tasirin kwarara fiye da kima, ka yi watsi da tasirin saurin tuƙi.
y-m-69-06.s.s1.o.d: Ba za a iya yanke hukunci ba sai an san faɗin kogin.
y-m-69-06.s.s1.r.d: Ka gauraya wurin sauka da faɗin kogi. Ko kwale-kwalen zai karkata gabas ana tantancewa ba tare da la'akari da faɗi ba.
y-m-69-06.s.s1.explain: Ainihin gudun (0+3, 5)=(3, 5) ne, bangaren gabas kuma ba 0 ba ne. Saboda haka ko yaya faɗin yake, kwale-kwalen zai sauka gabashin wurin da yake daidai da kai. Faɗin kawai yana kayyade nisan karkata.
y-m-69-06.s.s2.prompt: Tsara vector gudu 3 v=(p,q) mabambanta da q daban-daban waɗanda za su kai ka wurin da yake daidai da kai. Sharudda: bangaren gabas na ainihin gudu 0 ne, kwale-kwalen yana tafiya arewa (q>0), kuma gudunsa bai wuce iyakar 5 m/s ba.

y-m-69-06.s.s2.hint.1: Da zarar an kayyade p, rubuta sharadin gudu ga q a matsayin rashin daidaito, sannan ka bincika zangon yiwuwar.

y-m-69-06.s.s2.fail.c1: Dole ne ka zaɓi p ta yadda bangaren gabas p+3 na ainihin gudu ya zama 0.

y-m-69-06.s.s2.explain: p dole ya zama daidai −3 domin soke kwararar 3. Sannan daga p²+q²≤25 muna samun q²≤16, don haka 0<q≤4. Idan q=4, gudun (−3, 4) daidai 5 ne. Ƙaramin q ke nan, kwale-kwalen zai ketare a hankali.
y-m-69-06.s.s3.prompt: (1) Daga amsoshin da ka tsara, wanne ne zai ketare kogin da sauri kuma me ya sa? (2) Idan kogi yana gudana da 6 m/s, shin manufa ɗaya (isa daidai kishiya) za ta yiwu? Amsa da dalili.

y-m-69-08.title: Menene dangantakar tsakanin layuka biyu da suke layi ɗaya da jirgi?
y-m-69-08.topic: Matsayin layi da jirgi a sarari.
y-m-69-08.goal: Nuna da misalin layuka masu karkace da ba sa haɗuwa cewa iƙirarin 'layuka biyu masu layi ɗaya da jirgi ko dai sun haɗu ko kuma layi ɗaya ne' ba ya aiki; sannan ka gano ƙarin bayanin da zai tabbatar da cewa layuka biyu suna cikin jirgi guda.
y-m-69-08.material: A sarari, jirgi α shine jirgin xy (z=0). Layi yana layi ɗaya da α idan ba ya cikin α kuma ba ya haɗuwa da α. Sujin ta ce: “Layuka biyu masu layi ɗaya da α duka suna gefen jirgi α ɗaya, saboda haka koyaushe ko dai za su haɗu ko kuma su kasance layi ɗaya.” A sarari, layuka biyu da ba layi ɗaya ba kuma ba sa haɗuwa ana ce musu suna cikin 'matsayin karkace'.
